loadingScreen.tip7: In the stickers section, you can create and manage your own packs by uploading images in bulk.
loadingScreen.tip8: You can use the built-in player to listen to YouTube music in sync with the entire room.

loadingScreen.tip10: Onicord allows you to stream your screen or window in high definition directly to your voice channel peers.

network.title: Network Settings & ICE Fallbacks
network.description: If server members fail to connect to voice channels (for example, being behind restrictive firewalls or symmetric NAT), configure relay STUN and TURN servers here. If none are specified, Onicord will use default public fallback servers.
network.noServers: No custom servers. Default fallback servers will be used.
network.errorTurnPrefix: TURN URLs must begin with 'turn:' or 'turns:'
network.directDesc: Enables peer-to-peer connection via direct TCP socket. Bypassing the Hyperswarm DHT and relay servers, reducing voice latency to absolute minimum.
network.benefit1Desc: Ideal for LAN networks or if host has direct fiber.
network.benefit2Desc: Only the server host needs to open the port.
network.benefit3Desc: Automatic mDNS bypass for local audio.
network.privilegedPortWarning: Ports below 1024 are reserved and may require system administrator privileges. We recommend using a port between 1024 and 65535.
network.directLinkHint: Share this direct link with your friends. When opened, Onicord will automatically configure the IP and port to connect directly via TCP without passing through the public DHT.
network.fixStep1: Make sure you created a Port Forwarding rule in your router routing the selected port to your PC's private IP.
network.fixStep2: Verify your OS firewall (e.g. Windows Defender Firewall) allows incoming TCP connections on that port for Onicord.
network.fixStep3: Confirm you are not behind a restrictive symmetric NAT or CGNAT from your ISP.
network.iceBackupDesc: If server members fail to connect to voice lounges (due to restrictive firewalls or symmetric NAT), configure relay STUN/TURN servers here. Otherwise Onicord will use default public nodes.
